headline.funnel_interpretation: Insufficient studies to perform formal publication bias testing.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 2 studies yielded an effect size of 0.7 (95% CI: 0.3–1.65), indicating no statistically significant association between oats and breast cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 82.28%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
